notes.title: 正式版更新2021年10月24日
notes.content:
在二周目的新手村，增加了剧情段落跳转的NPC，方便大家二周目体验不同剧情，补成就。
修正了几个面部朝向不对或者意外卡住的问题。
修改了雕像无法正常获得对应成就的问题。
修改了作者故意留下的BUG成就的触发方式。
对于属性克制做出了更多的提示。
转职数值更加合理化。
略微修正了魔王军线的情节。
输入名称处理的修正（可以选择直接打字，但空名称视为错误）

notes.title: Closed beta version update
notes.content:
Optimization and update:

Global reinforcement and increased dialogue for guidance, flash tips and hint tasks.

The living environment of novice village residents has been greatly improved, and many scenes near novice village have been renovated.

Fixed the through wall bug in demon city.

The use effect of three kinds of fish was strengthened and the access was increased.

The phenomenon of dead ends has been greatly reduced.

Added achievements and eggs.

Fixed the mismatch between multiple walking diagrams and vertical drawings.

Fixed the female Lord's painful expression when casting spells.

The customs clearance description of the outcome of the branch line is optimized.

Fixed several obvious bugs lacking audio and few pictures.

The overall file volume of the game is greatly reduced.

Replaced a large number of BGM materials.

The acquisition of herbs is no longer all expressed in treasure chest.

When selecting key plot options, try to avoid misoperation caused by right-click cancellation.

The improvement effects of weapons and equipment in different stages are refined.

Simplified transfer.

Changed the resurrection prop name.

There are many, many, I can't remember completely

PS：

This game is a student's work, not for the primary purpose of business.

I hope you can experience simple and simple happiness from this game.
